test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: On the occasion of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, which of the following departments of the Government of India organised ‘Nari Samagam & Spardha’ – a Women Sports Meet in January 2023?

options.text: Department of Sports, Arts and Culture

solution:
The correct answer is __**Department of Personnel and Training**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The "Nari Samagam & Spardha" **women's sports meet was arranged by the** Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) **on** January 11, 2023,** with the **goal of encouraging women to participate in sports and cultural events.**
 
• The venue for the event was **New Delhi's Vinay Marg Sports Complex.**
 
• **Sujata Chaturvedi, **the secretary of sports, and S. Radha Chauhan, the secretary of DoPT, were the first women to attend.
 
• The first Indian female wrestler to win gold at the Asian and Commonwealth Games is Vinesh Phogat. She is the only female wrestler from India to have won several World Wrestling Championship medals.
 
• **Objectives**
 
 
• To raise consciousness and improve women's involvement in cultural and athletic endeavors.
 
• To take up healthier lives and boost confidence, teamwork, and self-worth.
 
• To enhance social abilities and foster good mindset
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• In terms of personnel matters, particularly those pertaining to hiring, training, career development, employee welfare, and post-retirement benefits, the Central Government's coordinating body is **the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions.**
 
• The process of modern, responsive, and people-oriented administration is another issue that the Ministry is concerned with.
 
• The Ministry's assigned job is defined under the Allocation of Business Rules. The following three Departments make up the Ministry.
